integrity: Exact symbolic resolvent/monotonicity proof with a standalone finite rational verification program. The finite program corroborates but does not certify the all-weight result.
scientific_limitations: Finite, connected symmetric weighted stars with all spoke conductances strictly positive; the theorem concerns the completed two-stage Gauss–Legendre step. No claim about internal-stage positivity, zero weights, general graphs, nonlinear dynamics, or independent validation. Priority remains subject to specialized literature coverage.
title: Sharp fourth-order Gauss positivity on every positively weighted star
